svg.title: Doubly periodic Scherk translator: numerical construction
svg.desc: A finite-boundary numerical translator patch and its half-turn extensions, reflected to the upward convention. The orange central patch repeats on the checkerboard lattice. Small corner fills and the displayed finite ends are approximate.

g.text: α = π/2 · w = π/2 · upward translation · finite-boundary numerical approximation
Numerical graph: edge heights ±2.5; picture cropped to |z| ≤ 1.5. Small corner fills are illustrative.
Hoffman–Martín–White, Theorem 3.1 and Figures 3, 8–10. No certified error bound.
